title: Quantum Door Anxiety
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Opening the doors will not be easy any more.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
Doors are now unstable portals. When you open a door, there is a high chance you will be randomly teleported to another existing door somewhere else in the world—or even in other dimensions—instead of just opening it.
